title: Tumble
problem: The +50% potency goes to Cascading gems cast by the side opposing the holder (all three calculators); the 3-charge cost tests the right side.
notes: Fix: S: swap the two side calls at each of 3 sites — in patch (byte-verified)

release_notes.intended: Your creatures' Cascading spell gems get 50% more potency.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, the bonus went to the opposing side's Cascading gems.
release_notes.fix: Now the bonus goes to the holder's side.
